title: Too much noise
instructions: Anna gürültü yapan komşusuyla konuşuyor. Sorunu ve uzlaşmayı takip et.

script.speaker: anna
script.text: Hi, I'm Anna from the flat downstairs. Sorry to bother you.

script.speaker: anna
script.text: Well, last night the music was very loud until two in the morning. I couldn't sleep.

script.speaker: ryan
script.text: Oh, I'm really sorry. It was my birthday party.

script.speaker: anna
script.text: Happy birthday! It's fine once, but it also happens at the weekends.

script.speaker: ryan
script.text: You're right. I'll keep the music quieter after eleven.

script.speaker: anna
script.text: Thank you. That would be great. I start work at six on Saturdays.

script.speaker: ryan
script.text: I didn't know that. Next time I have a party, I'll tell you first.

questions.evidence: I'm Anna from the flat downstairs.

questions.prompt: Why was there loud music last night?

options: to keep the music quieter after eleven
questions.feedback: Saat on birden sonra müziği kısacak.
